newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up, but off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up, but off early highs.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended up on Thursday on news that the IMF plans to resume payments of a stalled standby loan to Pakistan, but profit-taking later in the session cut early gains, dealers said.
"People reacted positively to the IMF's announcement, but profit-taking trimmed early gains," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "The market will remain stable as the rise in index is gradual."
The Karachi 100-share index rose 10.61 points, or 0.73 percent, to close at 1,455.85. Gainers led losers 127 to 81. PTCL rose 0.50 to 32.40 and Hub Power 0.60 to 34.30.
